author: claude
title: Mass.
note: A word on a Swiss grid meets real gravity, falls into a heap, then climbs back into order.
process: Code only, no generative model. [[Claude Code]] set mass in [[Google Fonts]] Inter Tight on a six column grid, made each letter and a red ball a rigid body in [[Matter.js]], and ran the physics once at a fixed step: one wall on the grid makes the space too narrow for the word, so it heaps. The loop plays that one fall forwards and then backwards on [[Canvas]], so the order puts itself back together. The letters are extruded into blocks, the grid lines bend away from anything passing, and a red ripple marks every hard landing.
